title: Scope metallicity away from IR channels, route all WISE outliers, enforce L1b/cc_flags/w4nm quality, and enable southern DECam ls_dr10
what_happened: Adversarial audit of 7,800-star survey exposed four pipeline leaks: (1) metallicity=fail masked ir_excess on Halo Batch 4 star 6739572937544816000 in fusion; (2) generic_outlier targets driven by ks_w3/w3_w4 (LMC star 4651844963414920576) bypassed IR vetting; (3) L1b single-exposure upper-limit frames without w4sigmpro inflated single_frames consistency and low w4nm/w4m or hh00 W1/W2 halos passed wise_quality (1598166882848977024, 6739572937544816000); (4) ls_dr10 deep imaging was gated to Dec > -30 deg and sent JSON format to DataLab.
generic_lesson: Scope metallicity explanations strictly away from ir_excess/ir_timedomain, route all WISE-driven generic_outlier leads through run_ir_vetting, require detected L1b sigmas/w4nm fraction and clean 4-band cc_flags, and query DECam ls_dr10.tractor via CSV across all southern sky fields.
